cases.name: Kristen Marie “Kiki” Galvan
cases.about: Kristen was known as “Kiki” by her family and friends. The teenager got good grades, was a member of the Girl Scouts and her school’s drill team, and had dreams of a career in the military. She was idolized by her two younger brothers, (her mother Robyn) Cory said.
cases.caseStatus: COLD CASE UNSOLVED; COLD CASE VICTIM IDENTIFIED; INVESTIGATIVE GENETIC GENEALOGY ID'D HER; POSSIBLE POLICE MISHANDLING
cases.narrative:
On 1/29/2020, her remains were found under a bridge in Missouri City, TX, 3 wekks after she disappeared. Only parts of her skull were recovered in 2020. Her limbs, lower body and part of her skull have never been found.

Kristen is believed to have been bound with duct tape, beaten and stabbed to death.
